examples.en: He joined a research institute after graduation.
examples.cn: 毕业后他进入一家研究所。

examples.en: They instituted a new training programme.
examples.cn: 他们设立了一个新的培训项目。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「硬是提土」——硬是提土来立招牌，就是设立机构

root: 拉丁语 stare「站立」→ statuere「使站立、设立」→ in- + statuere = instituere「设立、着手」→ institutum「惯例、安排」→ 古法语 institut → 英语 institute。与 institution、constitute、substitute 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: setting up a rule, the research body itself, and starting legal action.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：设立规则、研究机构本身，以及提起诉讼。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sign is planted in empty ground and marks out a new place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块牌子被插进空地，划出一片新领域。

branches.en: THE NOTICE: a new rule is put in force.
branches.cn: 公告这条线：新规则被实行。

branches.en: THE BUILDING: a body created for research or teaching.
branches.cn: 建筑这条线：为研究或教学建立的机构。

branches.en: THE COURT: a case is formally begun.
branches.cn: 法庭这条线：正式启动案件。

branches.en: THE LINK: every institute is itself instituted before it institutes anything.
branches.cn: 连接线：任何机构都要先被设立，才能设立别的。

branches.en: THE FORM: the legal sense belongs to a formal register.
branches.cn: 语域线：法律义属于正式语域。

intro.en: Institute is in- "in" plus the Latin statu- "set standing", with a participle ending.
intro.cn: institute 是 in-「入」加拉丁词干 statu-「使站立」，再带分词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin statuere, instituere and institutum are all recorded in classical and later texts.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 statuere、instituere、institutum 在古典及后世文献中均有记载。

items.example: It marks setting something in place.
The root also gives station and stable.
The causative verb supplies the core.
Institum names what has been set up.
The -ion form is far commoner today.
Con- shifts the sense.
Sub- means under.
The plain synonym of the verb sense.

definition_en: a large organisation such as a university or hospital, or an established custom
core_image: 石阶、石柱和一扇旧木门，门上的铜牌刻着机构的名字
scene: 冬天傍晚，医院门口的灯已经亮起，排队的队伍沿石阶往下。The hospital is the oldest institution in the town.
sceneCN: 这里 institution 是「机构」（第 1 个义项：大学、医院等大型组织），句意是这家医院是镇上最古老的机构。画面里能看到的物件：石阶、石柱、铜牌、灯。

pos.zh: 名词：机构；制度；由来已久的做法

derivatives.zh: 本词所对应的动词与名词，义为「设立；研究所」
由本词加 -al 构成，义为「机构的；制度性的」
由 institutional 加 -ize 构成，义为「制度化」
由 institutionalize 加 -d 构成，义为「已制度化的」

senses.title: An organisation
senses.definition: a large organisation set up for a public or professional purpose, such as a bank or a university
senses.definitionCN: 为公共或专业目的建立的大型组织，如银行或大学
senses.example: The museum is a public institution and entrance is free.
senses.exampleCN: 这家博物馆是公共机构，免费入场。
senses.why: Latin instituere "to set up" gives the result noun: something set up and standing on its own.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 instituere「设立」给出结果名词：被设立起来、独立存在的东西。

senses.title: An established custom
senses.titleCN: 由来已久的习俗与制度
senses.definition: a custom or practice that a society has long accepted and rarely questions
senses.definitionCN: 一个社会长期接受、很少质疑的习俗或做法
senses.example: The Sunday dinner is an institution in that family.
senses.exampleCN: 星期日聚餐在那个家庭里是雷打不动的惯例。
senses.why: A practice set up long ago and never taken down is felt as a thing standing there.
senses.whyCN: 很久以前设立、从未撤下的做法，会被感受为一件一直立在那里的事物。

senses.title: A place for care
senses.definition: a building where people are cared for over long periods, often used in older writing
senses.definitionCN: 长期照料人的场所，旧文常用此说法
senses.example: The old building was once an institution for orphaned children.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋旧楼曾是收容孤儿的机构。
senses.why: Buildings set up to keep and care for people took the general word for a set-up place.
senses.whyCN: 为收容和照料人而设立的场所沿用了「设立之处的通称」。

intro.en: Institution is the Latin noun of result from instituere "to set up", literally "something that has been set up".
intro.cn: institution 是拉丁语 instituere「设立」的结果名词，字面是「被设立起来的东西」。

items.en: Statuere "to make stand" and instituere "to set up" are both classical.
items.cn: statuere「使站立」与 instituere「设立」都是古典拉丁语词汇。

items.en: The noun institutio named the act of setting up or of teaching.
items.cn: 名词 institutio 指设立的行为或教导。

items.en: Old French institution passed into Middle English with both meanings.
items.cn: 古法语 institution 连同两层含义进入中古英语。

items.en: The eighteenth and nineteenth centuries made it the general word for social bodies.
items.cn: 十八、十九世纪它成为社会组织的通称。

items.en: Modern sociology uses it for customs and norms as well as buildings.
items.cn: 现代社会学用它兼指建筑与习俗规范。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -stitut- stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for organisations and customs.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -stitut- 词干；近义组收其他表示「组织」与「习俗」的词。

entries.definition: A research body, or the verb meaning to set one up.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「研究所」，动词义为「设立」。

entries.definition: The framework of rules that constitutes a state.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「宪法」，构成国家的规则框架。

entries.definition: The act of putting one thing in place of another.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「替换」。

entries.definition: Any structured group, without the sense of long establishment.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「组织」，不强调历史久远。

entries.definition: A usual practice, close to the second sense.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「习俗」，与第 2 义近义。

entries.definition: A group with a formal purpose, a bare synonym in formal writing.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「团体」，正式文体中可同义替换。

normalIntro.en: These hooks link the word to its verb and to the buildings and customs it names.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子把本词与它的动词以及它所命名的建筑、习俗联系起来。

normal.en: institute plus -ion: something set up and now standing.
normal.cn: institute 加 -ion：设立起来、如今站立的东西。

normal.en: Banks, hospitals and schools are all institutions.
normal.cn: 银行、医院、学校都是 institution。

normal.en: Institutional reform changes the rules, not the walls.
normal.cn: institutional reform 改的是规则，不是墙。

normal.en: A weekly dinner can be an institution too.
normal.cn: 每周一次的家庭聚餐也可以是一种惯例。

normal.en: Institutionalized people have lived long inside such places.
normal.cn: institutionalized 形容人长期生活在机构之中。

abstract.en: Institutions are habits with stone walls around them.
abstract.cn: 制度是围上了石墙的习惯。

abstract.en: A phrase becomes an institution once nobody remembers inventing it.
abstract.cn: 当一个说法没人记得是谁发明的，它就成了惯例。

abstract.en: Institutions are slow to change and slow to fall.
abstract.cn: 机构改变得慢，崩塌也慢。

examples.en: The bank is a respected financial institution.
examples.cn: 这家银行是受人尊敬的金融机构。

examples.en: Marriage is a social institution that varies by culture.
examples.cn: 婚姻是一种因文化而异的社会制度。

examples.en: They campaigned for institutional reform.
examples.cn: 他们为制度改革而奔走。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「硬是提土伸」——硬是提土伸出手，把机构搭起来

root: 拉丁语 statuere「使站立」→ instituere「设立」→ 名词 institutio「设立；教导」→ 古法语 institution → 中古英语。与 institute、constitute、substitute 同族，现代社会学用其指制度与习俗。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a formal organisation, a long-accepted custom, and an older word for a care home.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：正式组织、长期被接受的习俗，以及旧时指照料机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stone steps, pillars and an old wooden door with a brass nameplate.
core.cn: 核心意象：石阶、石柱与刻着名字的旧木门。

branches.en: THE DOORPLATE: a bank, a school, a museum.
branches.cn: 门牌这条线：银行、学校、博物馆。

branches.en: THE CALENDAR: a habit repeated until it is a rule.
branches.cn: 日历这条线：重复成规则的习俗。

branches.en: THE WARD: a place where people are cared for over years.
branches.cn: 病房这条线：长期照料人的场所。

branches.en: THE LINK: buildings and customs share the idea of an accepted arrangement.
branches.cn: 连接线：建筑与习俗共享「被接受的安排」这一观念。

branches.en: THE TONE: the care sense today sounds old or institutional.
branches.cn: 语气线：照料义如今显得陈旧或冷硬。

intro.en: Institution is in- plus the Latin stem statu- "set standing", with the noun ending -io.
intro.cn: institution 是 in- 加拉丁词干 statu-「使站立」，再加名词词尾 -io。

latinIntro.en: Latin instituere and institutio are both recorded, so this layer is fully attested.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 instituere 与 institutio 均有记载，这一层完全有据。

items.example: It marks placing in position.
The root runs through constitute.
The result sense dominates in English.
Institutional describes what belongs to institutions.
items.exampleCN: institutional 描述属于机构的事物。

items.example: Institutionalize makes something part of an institution.
items.exampleCN: institutionalize 指使之成为机构的一部分。

items.example: The shorter verb in the same family.

items.meaning: the setting up of a state
items.example: Con- plus the same stem.
A native synonym of the first sense.
items.exampleCN: 第一义的本族语近义词。

definition_zh: 说明；指示；（复数）操作指南；教学
definition_en: information telling you how to do something, an order, or the act of teaching
core_image: 一张折叠的纸从包装盒里滑出来，上面一行行写着步骤
scene: 新买的书架零件摊在地上，说明书被风翻到第二页。Read the instructions before you switch the machine on.
sceneCN: 这里 instruction 是「说明、操作指南」（第 1 个义项：告诉你如何做某事的信息），句意是开机前先读说明。画面里能看到的物件：说明书、零件、包装盒。

pos.zh: 名词：说明；指示；教学（常用复数）

derivatives.zh: 本词所对应的动词，义为「指导；指示」
由本词加 -al 构成，义为「教学的；指导性的」
由动词加 -ive 构成，义为「有教益的」
由动词加 -or 构成，义为「教练；讲师」

senses.title: Guidance on how to do something
senses.definition: information that tells you how to do or use something, often written down step by step
senses.definitionCN: 告诉你怎么做或怎么使用某物的信息，常分步骤写成文字
senses.example: The instructions say to wash the filter every month.
senses.exampleCN: 说明书上说每月清洗一次滤网。
senses.why: The Latin noun instructio names the arranging of things in order, and a written guide is an arrangement of steps.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁名词 instructio 指把事物按顺序安排，而书面指南正是对步骤的安排。

senses.title: An order from someone in charge
senses.definition: a direction or order given by a person with authority
senses.definitionCN: 由有权者给出的指示或命令
senses.example: The pilot never received the instruction to land.
senses.exampleCN: 飞行员始终没收到着陆指示。
senses.why: An arranged sequence of actions is also a sequence someone has told you to follow.
senses.whyCN: 被排好顺序的一套动作，也是有人吩咐你去照做的顺序。

senses.title: Teaching in general
senses.definition: the activity of teaching a subject or skill, especially in a school or course
senses.definitionCN: 教授某科目或技能的活动，尤指在学校或课程中
senses.example: The school pays attention to the quality of instruction.
senses.exampleCN: 这所学校重视教学质量。
senses.why: The oldest sense keeps the idea of building knowledge; written guides and orders are later branches.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项保留「建造知识」的观念；书面说明与命令是后来分出的枝。

intro.en: Instruction is the Latin noun of action from instruere "to build in, teach", based on struere "to build".
intro.cn: instruction 是拉丁语 instruere「在内部建造、教导」的行为名词，基于 struere「建造」。

items.en: Struere "to build, pile up" underlies a large family of building words.
items.cn: struere「建造、堆积」是一大类「建筑」词的根基。

items.en: Instruere meant to draw up in order, to equip, and to teach.
items.cn: instruere 意为「按序排列、装备、教导」。

items.en: The noun instructio named the arrangement and the teaching.
items.cn: 名词 instructio 指安排与教导。

items.en: Old French instruction carried the word into Middle English.
items.cn: 古法语 instruction 把这个词带入中古英语。

items.en: Printing and machinery made instruction the ordinary word for a written guide.
items.cn: 印刷与机器让 instruction 成为「书面说明」的常用词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -struct- stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for guidance and orders.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -struct- 词干；近义组收其他表示「指引」与「命令」的词。

entries.definition: The adjective meaning designed for teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「教学用的」。

entries.definition: The act of building something physical.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「建造」，指实体施工。

entries.definition: The opposite of building, with de- meaning down.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「破坏」，前缀 de- 表「向下」。

entries.definition: Guidance on where to go or what to do, often spoken.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指引」，常指口头的。

entries.definition: A book of instructions for a device.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「使用手册」，指设备说明书。

entries.definition: Help and advice over time, gentler than instruction.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指导」，比 instruction 温和。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the building stem and the plural habit behind most real instructions.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子利用「建造」词干，以及真实使用中「说明」多为复数的习惯。

normal.en: struct- builds: instruction is knowledge stacked in steps.
normal.cn: struct- 建造：instruction 是分步叠起的知识。

normal.en: Instructions usually come in the plural when printed.
normal.cn: 印在纸上的说明通常用复数 instructions。

normal.en: Follow the instructions and the shelf will fit together.
normal.cn: 照着说明做，书架就能拼起来。

normal.en: Instructional materials are made for teaching.
normal.cn: instructional materials 是教学材料。

normal.en: Give clear instructions, then check they were understood.
normal.cn: 给清晰的指示，然后确认对方听懂了。

abstract.en: Picture a folded paper sliding out of a new box.
abstract.cn: 想象一张折纸从新盒子里滑出来。

abstract.en: Good instructions leave no room for guessing.
abstract.cn: 好的说明不给猜测留空间。

abstract.en: Instruction is a bridge built between two minds.
abstract.cn: instruction 是架在两个头脑之间的桥。

examples.en: Read the instructions carefully before use.
examples.cn: 使用前请仔细阅读说明。

examples.en: He gave clear instructions to the new staff.
examples.cn: 他向新员工下达了清晰的指示。

examples.en: The course offers instruction in basic statistics.
examples.cn: 这门课提供基础统计学的教学。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因斯抓克神」——因为抓得准，才能写出神气的说明

root: 拉丁语 struere「建造」→ instruere「按序排列、装备、教导」→ 行为名词 instructio「安排；教导」→ 古法语 instruction → 中古英语。与 construct、structure、instruct 同族。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: written guidance, an order from authority, and teaching in general.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：书面说明、上级指示，以及泛指的教学。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a folded sheet slides from the box and lists the steps in order.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张折页从盒中滑出，按序列出步骤。

branches.en: THE SHEET: written steps for using something.
branches.cn: 纸张这条线：使用某物的书面步骤。

branches.en: THE RADIO: an order arriving from authority.
branches.cn: 无线电这条线：来自权力的命令。

branches.en: THE SCHOOL: the activity of teaching itself.
branches.cn: 学校这条线：教学这一活动本身。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are organised guidance, one on paper and one in a room.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是有组织的指导，一在纸上，一在课堂。

branches.en: THE TONE: the order sense is the most official.
branches.cn: 语气线：「指示」义最正式。

intro.en: Instruction is the stem instruct- plus the Latin noun ending -ion.
intro.cn: instruction 是词干 instruct- 加拉丁名词词尾 -ion。

latinIntro.en: Latin instruere and instructio are attested; the noun of action is regular.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 instruere 与 instructio 均有记载，行为名词构成规则。

items.example: It marks the building being done inside.
items.exampleCN: 它标出建造发生在内部。

items.example: The root is visible in structure.
It forms the abstract noun.
Instructional is used of materials and design.
items.exampleCN: instructional 多用于材料与设计。

items.example: The shorter verb behind the noun.
The person who gives instruction.
A common partner word in real texts.
items.exampleCN: 实际文本中的常见搭配词。

items.example: A near synonym in spoken use.

definition_zh: 仪器；器械；乐器；工具；手段
definition_en: a tool or device used for a particular purpose, especially for music, measuring, or surgery
core_image: 桌面上摊开一把小提琴、一把卡尺和一支手术钳
scene: 维修台上工具按大小排开，最细的那把镊子闪着光。The clinic bought a new instrument for measuring blood pressure.
sceneCN: 这里 instrument 是「仪器、器械」（第 1 个义项：为特定用途制作的工具或装置），句意是诊所买了一台测血压的新仪器。画面里能看到的物件：镊子、卡尺、维修台。

pos.zh: 名词：仪器；器械；乐器；工具；手段

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -al 构成，义为「起重要作用的；器乐的」
由 instrumental 加 -ation 构成，义为「仪器配置；配器法」
由 instrumental 加 -ist 构成，义为「器乐演奏者」

senses.title: A device for a purpose
senses.definition: a tool or piece of equipment made for careful or technical work, such as measuring or surgery
senses.definitionCN: 为精细或技术性工作制作的工具或设备，如测量、手术用
senses.example: The dentist laid out her instruments in a row.
senses.exampleCN: 牙医把器械排成一排。
senses.why: Latin instruere "to equip" gives instrumentum, "that with which one is equipped".
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 instruere「装备」给出 instrumentum，意为「用来装备自己的东西」。

senses.title: A musical instrument
senses.definition: an object such as a violin or a flute that is played to make music
senses.definitionCN: 小提琴、长笛等用来演奏音乐的器物
senses.example: He can play three instruments but sings badly.
senses.exampleCN: 他会演奏三种乐器，但唱歌很差。
senses.why: Music moved into the same word because the body and its pipes are also equipment for an effect.
senses.whyCN: 音乐进入这个词，是因为身体与其吹管同样是产生效果的「装备」。

senses.title: A means of achieving something
senses.definition: a person, law, or method used as a way of getting something done
senses.definitionCN: 被用来促成某事的人、法律或方法
senses.example: Language is the main instrument of thought.
senses.exampleCN: 语言是思维的主要工具。
senses.why: The equipment imagery widens to anything used as a means, including laws and words.
senses.whyCN: 「装备」的意象扩大到任何被用作手段的东西，包括法律与语言。

intro.en: Instrument comes from Latin instrumentum "equipment", built on instruere "to equip, arrange".
intro.cn: instrument 来自拉丁语 instrumentum「装备、器械」，由 instruere「装备、安排」构成。

items.en: Struere "to build, pile up" is the root that also gives structure.
items.cn: struere「建造、堆积」也是 structure 的词根。

items.en: Instruere meant to equip or set out in order.
items.cn: instruere 意为「装备、按序陈设」。

items.en: Instrumentum was any equipment, a document, or a means.
items.cn: instrumentum 指任何装备、文书或手段。

items.en: Old French instrument named tools and musical instruments in the Middle Ages.
items.cn: 古法语 instrument 在中世纪指工具与乐器。

items.en: Science and medicine gave the word its precise modern sense of a measuring device.
items.cn: 科学与医学赋予它「测量装置」这一精确的现代含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -stru- building stem; the near-meaning group holds other words for tools and devices.
note.cn: 形近组共享 -stru-「建造」词干；近义组收其他表示「工具、装置」的词。

entries.definition: Playing an important part, or music without words.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「起重要作用的」或「器乐的」。

entries.definition: The arrangement of parts in a whole.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「结构」。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to equip or teach.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「装备；教导」。

entries.definition: The plain general word for something held and used.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「工具」，最一般的说法。

entries.definition: A machine made for a specific job, often small.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「装置」，常指小型机器。

entries.definition: A set of equipment for scientific use.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「仪器设备」，多指科学用成套设备。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the "equipment" sense inside the word and its three big fields.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子利用词内「装备」之义，以及这个词的三大领域。

normal.en: instruere is to equip: an instrument is equipment for a special job.
normal.cn: instruere 是装备：instrument 是为特定工作准备的装备。

normal.en: One word covers violins, scalpels and rulers.
normal.cn: 同一个词覆盖小提琴、手术刀与尺子。

normal.en: Play an instrument; use an instrument.
normal.cn: 演奏乐器用 play an instrument；使用器械用 use an instrument。

normal.en: Instrumental means playing a key part.
normal.cn: instrumental 义为「起关键作用的」。

normal.en: Same stem as instruct and structure.
normal.cn: 与 instruct、structure 同词干。

abstract.en: Picture a table where a violin, a caliper and a scalpel lie side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上小提琴、卡尺与手术刀并排放着。

abstract.en: Every instrument extends a hand.
abstract.cn: 每一件器械都是手的延伸。

abstract.en: Ideas too can be instruments, sharp or blunt.
abstract.cn: 思想也可以是工具，或利或钝。

examples.en: The laboratory instruments are checked every year.
examples.cn: 实验室仪器每年检测一次。

examples.en: The violin is the instrument she plays best.
examples.cn: 小提琴是她最擅长的乐器。

examples.en: The law was used as an instrument of change.
examples.cn: 这项法律被用作变革的工具。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「硬是吹门他」——他硬是吹着门上的乐器，可见是乐器

root: 拉丁语 struere「建造」→ instruere「装备、按序陈设」→ instrumentum「装备、器械、手段」→ 古法语 instrument → 中古英语。与 instruct、structure、instrumental 同族，现代科学和医学使其专指精密测量器械。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a technical device, a musical object, and a means to an end.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：专业技术器械、乐器，以及达到目的的手段。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a violin, a caliper and a scalpel lie open on the same table.
core.cn: 核心意象：小提琴、卡尺与手术刀摊在同一张桌上。

branches.en: THE CLINIC: precise devices for measuring and repairing.
branches.cn: 诊所这条线：用于测量与修复的精密器械。

branches.en: THE ENSEMBLE: an object built to make music.
branches.cn: 乐队这条线：为发出音乐而造的器物。

branches.en: THE ARGUMENT: a law or a language treated as a tool.
branches.cn: 论证这条线：法律或语言被当作工具。

branches.en: THE LINK: both are things used to get an effect.
branches.cn: 连接线：两者都是用来产生效果的东西。

branches.en: THE PLEASURE: the music sense is the warmest of the three.
branches.cn: 语气线：乐器义最富情感温度。

intro.en: Instrument is the Latin stem instru- plus the noun ending -mentum, English -ment.
intro.cn: instrument 是拉丁词干 instru- 加名词词尾 -mentum（英语 -ment）。

latinIntro.en: Latin instruere and instrumentum are well recorded, so this layer is fully attested.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 instruere 与 instrumentum 记载充分，这一层完全有据。

items.example: It marks equipping from within.
The root runs through construct.
It names the thing used.
Instrumental means serving as a means.
Instrumentalist names a player.
The plainest synonym.

items.meaning: a made thing with a job
items.example: A machine-flavoured synonym.
The formal word for a set of instruments.

definition_zh: 保险；保险费；保险业；保障
definition_en: an arrangement in which a company pays for loss or damage in return for regular payments, or the money paid for it
core_image: 一张纸写着「出事由我赔」，旁边是一摞按月交钱的小票
scene: 柜台上放着一份厚厚的保单，客户在末尾签下了名字。She pays a small sum each month for travel insurance.
sceneCN: 这里 insurance 是「保险」（第 1 个义项：花钱买一份出事后可索赔的保障），句意为她每月交一笔小钱买旅行保险。画面里的物件：保单、签名笔、缴费小票。

pos.zh: 名词：保险；保险费；保险业；保障

derivatives.zh: 由本词去尾构成，义为「给……保险；确保」
由 insure 加 -er 构成，义为「保险公司；承保人」
由 insure 加 -ed 构成，义为「已投保的」
由 insure 加 -able 构成，义为「可保险的」

senses.title: Cover against loss
senses.definition: an agreement in which a company promises to pay you if you suffer loss, damage, or injury
senses.definitionCN: 一种约定：一旦你遭受损失、损坏或伤害，公司承诺向你赔付
senses.example: My grandfather has kept the same insurance on his house for thirty years.
senses.exampleCN: 我祖父那栋房子的保险三十年没换过。
senses.why: Latin securus means "free from care"; insurance is the promise that someone will take care of the loss.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 securus 意为「无忧」，insurance 就是有人会替你承担损失的那句承诺。

senses.title: The money you pay
senses.definition: the regular sum of money paid to a company so that the agreement stays in force
senses.definitionCN: 为使约定持续有效而定期交给公司的一笔钱
senses.example: The insurance on the old van costs more than the van is worth.
senses.exampleCN: 这辆旧货车的保险费比车本身还值钱。
senses.why: In everyday speech the abstract promise and the money paid for it share one word.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，抽象的那份承诺和为它付的钱共用同一个词。

senses.title: The business itself
senses.definition: the industry or practice of selling this kind of protection
senses.definitionCN: 出售这类保障的行业或做法
senses.example: Insurance is one of the biggest employers in that city.
senses.exampleCN: 保险业是那座城市最大的雇主之一。
senses.why: From a single policy the word widened to name the whole trade built on policies.
senses.whyCN: 从一张保单出发，这个词扩展成了建立在保单之上的整个行业。

senses.title: A safeguard in general
senses.definition: anything that protects you or makes a bad outcome less likely
senses.definitionCN: 任何能保护你、或使坏结果不易发生的事物
senses.example: Saving money is the best insurance against a sudden job loss.
senses.exampleCN: 存钱是应对突然失业的最好保障。
senses.why: The figurative use moves from paperwork to life: whatever cushions a shock works like insurance.
senses.whyCN: 比喻用法从纸面文件转到生活中：任何能缓冲冲击的东西都像保险一样起作用。

intro.en: Insurance grew out of the Latin adjective securus through French; the ending shifted in English to suit the trade.
intro.cn: insurance 源自拉丁语形容词 securus，经法语进入英语，词尾在英语里为适应这个行业而发生了变化。

items.en: The adjective securus, from se- "without" and cura "care", meant "free from care".
items.cn: 形容词 securus 由 se-「无」与 cura「忧虑」合成，义为「无忧的」。

items.en: Medieval merchants used securitas for the merchant guarantee behind a sea loan.
items.cn: 中世纪商人用 securitas 指海上借贷背后的商业担保。

items.en: Old French ensured the word as enseurance, meaning a promise to make someone safe.
items.cn: 古法语把它定型为 enseurance，意为「使人安全的承诺」。

items.en: English merchants of the sixteenth century used assurance for sea trade; insurance replaced it for the business of paying against risk.
items.cn: 十六世纪的英国商人用 assurance 指海上贸易；insurance 后来接替它表示对风险赔付的行业。

items.en: In the nineteenth century insurance broadened from ships to houses, health, and finally to any safeguard in speech.
items.cn: 十九世纪 insurance 从船舶扩展到房屋、健康，最后在日常言语中泛指任何保障。

note.en: The look-alike group hangs on the same Latin root of care and safety; the near-meaning group holds other words for protection.
note.cn: 形近组都挂在「忧虑、安全」这个拉丁词根上；近义组收其他表示保护的词。

entries.definition: A firm promise; in British English also a kind of life cover.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保证」，英式英语中也指某类人寿保险。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to arrange cover or to make certain.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「投保；确保」。

entries.definition: Safe, or to fasten and make safe.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「安全的」，动词义为「使牢固、弄稳」。

entries.definition: The written contract of an insurance arrangement.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保单」，即保险的书面合同。

entries.definition: The fixed amount paid regularly for cover.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保险费」，即定期缴纳的固定金额。

entries.definition: The general state of being kept safe, wider than any contract.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「保护」，比合同意义上的保险更宽泛。

normalIntro.en: These hooks attach to the idea of care and the phrases insurance really appears in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子围绕「忧虑、照看」这个念头，并挂上 insurance 的真实搭配。

normal.en: in- plus sur- means "into the sure": you buy your way into safety.
normal.cn: in- 加 sur- 是「进入保险状态」：花钱买进安全里。

normal.en: The same family gives insure, assured and secure.
normal.cn: 同一词族给出 insure、assured、secure。

normal.en: An insurance company sells promises, not goods.
normal.cn: 保险公司卖的是承诺，而不是货物。

normal.en: Health insurance is the first thing a family budgets for.
normal.cn: 健康保险是一个家庭预算里最先安排的一项。

normal.en: Saving is insurance against the unexpected.
normal.cn: 储蓄是对意外的一种保险。

abstract.en: Insurance is a crowd sharing one person's bad day.
abstract.cn: 保险是一群人共同分担一个人的倒霉日子。

abstract.en: A policy is paper that turns into money only when things go wrong.
abstract.cn: 保单是一张只在出事时才变成钱的纸。

abstract.en: The word means care removed: someone else now carries the worry.
abstract.cn: 这个词的意思是「忧虑被移走」：如今别人替你担着那份心。

examples.en: The repair bill was far less painful because of his insurance.
examples.cn: 因为有保险，那笔修理费让人轻松多了。

examples.en: Insurance for the whole family rose again this year.
examples.cn: 全家的保险费今年又涨了。

examples.en: She treats a full pantry as insurance against hard times.
examples.cn: 她把塞满的储物柜当作应对艰难时日的保障。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阴输瑞思」——阴天输了也不慌，因为有保险

root: 拉丁语 cura「忧虑」→ securus「无忧的」→ 中世纪拉丁语 securitas「担保」→ 古法语 enseurance → 英语 insurance。同族词还有 insure、assurance、secure。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: the promise of cover, the money paid for it, the trade that sells it, and any safeguard in ordinary life.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：赔付的承诺、为此付的钱、出售它的行业，以及生活中任何形式的保障。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a signed promise that a loss will be paid for.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张签好的承诺，保证损失会有人赔付。

branches.en: THE CONTRACT: the company promises to pay when loss happens.
branches.cn: 合同这条线：公司承诺出事就赔。

branches.en: THE PREMIUM: the money handed over keeps the promise alive.
branches.cn: 保费这条线：交出去的钱让承诺继续有效。

branches.en: THE TRADE: a whole industry lives on selling such promises.
branches.cn: 行业这条线：整个产业靠出售这类承诺生存。

branches.en: THE SAVINGS JAR: anything that softens a shock acts as insurance.
branches.cn: 存钱罐这条线：任何能缓冲冲击的东西都起到保险作用。

branches.en: THE LINK: promise and payment are two sides of the same policy.
branches.cn: 连接线：承诺与付款是同一张保单的两面。

intro.en: Insurance splits into the negative prefix in-, the root secur- "care-free", and the noun ending -ance.
intro.cn: insurance 可拆为否定前缀 in-、词根 secur-「无忧」与名词词尾 -ance。

latinIntro.en: Latin cura and securus are well attested; only the deepest Indo-European layer is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 cura 与 securus 均有记载，只有最深层的印欧语形式属于重构。

items.example: It marks entry into a safe state.
items.exampleCN: 它标出进入安全状态的动作。

items.example: The root also lives in secure and security.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 secure 与 security。

items.example: The noun is the oldest member of the family.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词是这一词族最古老的成员。

items.example: The adjective joins se- with cura.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词由 se- 与 cura 合成。

items.example: Medieval use shifted it towards a guarantee.
items.exampleCN: 中世纪用法使它转向「担保」。

items.example: It turns the stem into an abstract noun.
items.exampleCN: 它把词干变成抽象名词。

items.example: The verb was borrowed from Old French.
The suffix names the one who acts.
items.exampleCN: 后缀标出动作的施行者。

definition_zh: 智力的；知识分子的；n. 知识分子
definition_en: relating to thinking and understanding, or a person who lives by ideas and study
core_image: 书桌上一摞书、一叠写满的字纸，窗外的声音都被关在玻璃外
scene: 书房里的人整晚没离开过椅子，桌上摊着好几本书和批注。Her intellectual curiosity took her from farming villages to a research library.
sceneCN: 这里 intellectual 是「智力的、求知方面的」（第 1 个义项：与思考理解有关），句意为求知的好奇心把她从农村带到研究图书馆。画面里的物件：摊开的书、批注笔、窗玻璃。

pos.zh: 形容词：智力的；脑力的；有才智的

derivatives.zh: 由本词的词干构成，义为「智力；才智」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「在智力上」
由同一拉丁词干构成，义为「智力；情报」
由同一词干构成，义为「可理解的」

senses.title: Of thinking and learning
senses.definition: concerned with the ability to think, reason, and understand rather than with the body
senses.definitionCN: 关乎思考、推理与理解的能力，而非身体
senses.example: Chess is an intellectual game played mostly in silence.
senses.exampleCN: 国际象棋是一种几乎在静默中进行的智力游戏。
senses.why: Latin intellegere means to pick out and understand; -ual marks a quality.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intellegere 意为「辨出并理解」，-ual 标出性质。

senses.title: Enjoying ideas
senses.definition: enjoying serious reading, discussion, and ideas for their own sake
senses.definitionCN: 以严肃的阅读、讨论与思考本身为乐
senses.example: Their conversations were intellectual and went on until dawn.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的谈话富于思考，一直持续到天亮。
senses.why: By the eighteenth century the adjective described a lively taste for debate and learning.
senses.whyCN: 到十八世纪，这个形容词用来形容对辩论与学问的浓厚兴致。

senses.title: A person of ideas
senses.definition: a person, especially a well-known one, who writes or speaks seriously about ideas
senses.definitionCN: 尤指知名的人，认真写作或谈论思想的人
senses.example: The newspaper invited several intellectuals to argue about education.
senses.exampleCN: 报纸邀请了几位知识分子讨论教育问题。
senses.why: The noun use spread in the late nineteenth century, often with a faint hint of suspicion.
senses.whyCN: 名词用法在十九世纪末流行开来，往往略带一点怀疑的意味。

intro.en: Intellectual goes back to Latin intellegere, whose heart is legere "to choose, to read".
intro.cn: intellectual 上溯到拉丁语 intellegere，其核心是 legere「挑选、读」。

items.en: Legere meant to gather or pick, and so to read; inter- means "between, among".
items.cn: legere 意为「采集、挑」，因而「阅读」；inter- 意为「在……之间」。

items.en: Intellegere thus means to pick out the sense among things, that is, to understand.
items.cn: 因此 intellegere 意为在事物之间辨出意义，也就是理解。

items.en: Intellectualis was a later adjective used for the thinking part of the mind.
items.cn: intellectualis 是后期形容词，用于心灵中思考的那部分。

items.en: English adopted intellectual in the Middle Ages for what belongs to understanding.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪借入 intellectual，指属于理解力的东西。

items.en: The noun intellectual, a person of ideas, dates from the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 作名词表示「知识分子」的用法始于十九世纪。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the legere root; the near-meaning group holds other words about minds and thinking.
note.cn: 形近组共享 legere 词根；近义组收其他与头脑、思考有关的词。

entries.definition: The ability to learn, or secret information.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「智力」，也指情报。

entries.definition: Clear enough to be understood.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「明白易懂的」。

entries.definition: Good at learning and reasoning.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「聪明的」。

entries.definition: Connected with schools and formal study.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「学术的」，与学校、正规研究有关。

entries.definition: Careful and thorough in study, like a scholar.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「治学严谨的」。

entries.definition: Appealing to thought more than feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「诉诸思考的」，偏书卷气。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the legere root of reading and the real phrases around this adjective.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子利用「读」这一词根 legere，并挂上这个形容词的真实搭配。

normal.en: intellect plus -ual: the quality of understanding.
normal.cn: intellect 加 -ual：理解力的性质。

normal.en: Do not steal intellectual property; it belongs to its maker.
normal.cn: 不要盗取知识产权，它属于创造者。

normal.en: An intellectual lives on books, argument, and little sleep.
normal.cn: 知识分子靠书、辩论和很少的睡眠过活。

normal.en: The same root gives intelligence and intelligible.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 intelligence 与 intelligible。

normal.en: Intellectual work tires the mind, not the hands.
normal.cn: 脑力劳动累的是头脑，不是双手。

abstract.en: An intellectual is someone who cannot stop asking why.
abstract.cn: 知识分子是那种停不下问「为什么」的人。

abstract.en: Intellectual life is a conversation carried across centuries.
abstract.cn: 智识生活是一场跨越几个世纪的对话。

abstract.en: Thinking well is the quietest form of courage.
abstract.cn: 好好思考是最安静的一种勇气。

examples.en: He took an intellectual interest in how languages change.
examples.cn: 他对语言如何演变抱有学术上的兴趣。

examples.en: The magazine was written for a general intellectual audience.
examples.cn: 这本杂志是写给一般有学识的读者看的。

examples.en: She became a respected intellectual after publishing two books on law.
examples.cn: 发表两本法学著作后，她成了一位受人尊敬的知识分子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特莱克」——在因特网上猛查资料，成为知识分子

root: 拉丁语 legere「挑选、读」→ inter-「在……之间」+ legere → intellegere「辨出、理解」→ intellectualis「理解力的」→ 英语 intellectual。同族词：intellect、intelligence、intelligible。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: of the mind, fond of ideas, and as a noun, a person of ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：属于头脑的、喜爱思想的，以及作名词指「知识分子」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp-lit desk piled with books while the street stays outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：台灯下的书桌堆满书，街道被关在外面。

branches.en: THE CHESSBOARD: the thinking part of a game is on show.
branches.cn: 棋盘这条线：展现的是游戏里思考的那部分。

branches.en: THE LONG TALK: ideas are enjoyed for their own sake.
branches.cn: 长谈这条线：为思想本身而享受思想。

branches.en: THE NEWSPAPER: named persons are asked to speak about ideas.
branches.cn: 报纸这条线：具名的人被请来谈思想。

branches.en: THE LINK: the quality and the person named after it.
branches.cn: 连接线：性质与其被命名的承载者。

branches.en: THE LINK: a taste for debate marks the type.
branches.cn: 连接线：爱辩论的趣味标出这一类人。

intro.en: Intellectual = inter- "among" + leg- "gather, read" + -ual "of the nature of".
intro.cn: intellectual = inter-「在……之间」+ leg-「采集、读」+ -ual「……性质的」。

latinIntro.en: Latin intellegere and intellectualis are both recorded forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intellegere 与 intellectualis 都是有记载的形式。

items.example: It puts the picking between things.
items.exampleCN: 它把「挑选」放在事物之间。

items.example: The root reappears in lecture and legend.
items.exampleCN: 词根也见于 lecture 与 legend。

items.example: The verb is the true ancestor.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是真正的祖先。

items.example: The English noun intellect comes from it.
items.exampleCN: 英语名词 intellect 来自它。

items.example: It makes the abstract adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它构成这个抽象形容词。

items.example: It gives intellectually.
The noun is shorter and older.
The prefix marks opposition.

definition_en: the ability to learn, understand, and reason, or secret information about an enemy
core_image: 有人在棋盘上看清十几步后的局面，同时有人把密信交到暗处
scene: 实验室里摆着拼图、棋子和一套做记录的量表，受试者正埋头解题。Tests of intelligence rarely capture how quickly a child learns.
sceneCN: 这里 intelligence 是「智力」（第 1 个义项：学习、理解与推理的能力），句意为智力测验很少能捕捉孩子学得多快。画面里的物件：拼图、棋子、记录表。

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「聪明的」
由 intelligent 加 -ly 构成，义为「明智地」
由词干加 -ible 构成，义为「可理解的」
由同一词干构成，义为「智力的」

senses.title: The power to learn and reason
senses.definition: the general ability to learn facts, understand ideas, and solve problems
senses.definitionCN: 学习事实、理解观念并解决问题的总体能力
senses.example: Her intelligence showed less in tests than in the questions she asked.
senses.exampleCN: 她的智力更多体现在提的问题里，而不是分数里。
senses.why: Latin intellegere, "to understand", gives the noun its core of understanding.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 intellegere「理解」给这个名词以「理解」的内核。

senses.title: Secret information
senses.definition: information gathered about an enemy or rival, often secretly
senses.definitionCN: 常以秘密方式收集的关于敌方或对手的信息
senses.example: Naval intelligence warned the fleet two days ahead.
senses.exampleCN: 海军情报提前两天警告了舰队。
senses.why: This sense grew in military writing in the sixteenth century, where knowledge itself is a weapon.
senses.whyCN: 这一义项在十六世纪的军事写作中成长起来，在那里知识本身就是武器。

senses.title: A mind or being that knows
senses.definition: a thinking being, or in modern use a machine that seems to think
senses.definitionCN: 会思考的生灵，或现代用法中指看似会思考的机器
senses.example: Scientists argue about whether any machine intelligence can be friendly.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家在争论机器智能是否可能是友善的。
senses.why: The word shifts from a power to the possessor of that power.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从一种能力转向拥有这种能力的主体。

senses.title: News or information
senses.definition: formal or old-fashioned news about some event
senses.definitionCN: 关于某事的正式或旧式说法「消息」
senses.example: The family waited for intelligence from the frontier.
senses.exampleCN: 家人等着边疆传来的消息。
senses.why: The oldest English use simply meant tidings brought by a messenger.
senses.whyCN: 最早的英语用法只指信使带来的音信。

intro.en: Intelligence is the Latin noun intelligentia, built on intellegere "to understand".
intro.cn: intelligence 是拉丁语名词 intelligentia，建构在 intellegere「理解」之上。

items.en: Legere "to gather, read" with inter- "among" yields intellegere, "to pick out the sense".
items.cn: legere「采集、读」与 inter-「在……之间」合成 intellegere「辨出意义」。

items.en: Intelligentia named the power of understanding in classical philosophy.
items.cn: intelligentia 在古典哲学中指理解的能力。

items.en: French intelligence carried both understanding and news.
items.cn: 法语 intelligence 既指理解，也指消息。

items.en: English kept both senses; the news sense later narrowed to military and secret reports.
items.cn: 英语保留了两种意义；消息义后来窄化为军事与秘密报告。

items.en: The twentieth century added artificial intelligence and machine intelligence.
items.cn: 二十世纪添上了人工智能与机器智能的说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the understanding root; the near-meaning group holds words about mental power.
note.cn: 形近组共享「理解」词根；近义组收表示心智能力的词。

entries.definition: The adjective for a person or animal that learns well.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，形容人或动物学习能力强。

entries.definition: The faculty of reasoning, in the abstract.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，抽象地指推理能力。

entries.definition: Able to be understood by the hearer.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「能被听懂看懂的」。

entries.definition: The same power seen as a separate faculty.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，把同一能力看作单独的官能。

entries.definition: Good judgement gained from experience, not speed.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「智慧」，来自经验而非反应快。

entries.definition: Facts of any kind, open or secret.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「信息」，公开或秘密的事实。

normalIntro.en: The hooks join the legere root of reading to the two faces of the word: mind and secret news.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把「读」这一词根 legere 与这个词的两张面孔合起来：心智与秘密消息。

normal.en: intellegere: to read among things means to understand them.
normal.cn: intellegere：在事物之间读懂，就是理解它们。

normal.en: Artificial intelligence is still only a clever reader of patterns.
normal.cn: 人工智能仍只是个会读图案的聪明角色。

normal.en: Military intelligence is information treated as a weapon.
normal.cn: 军事情报是被当作武器的信息。

normal.en: Intelligence tests measure only what tests can measure.
normal.cn: 智力测验只能测出测验能测的东西。

normal.en: The same root gives intelligent and intelligible.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 intelligent 与 intelligible。

abstract.en: Intelligence is the mind finding a path where none was drawn.
abstract.cn: 智力是头脑在没有路的地方找出路。

abstract.en: Knowing the enemy is half the battle, hence intelligence.
abstract.cn: 知敌者半胜，所以有情报之说。

abstract.en: A quiet question can show more intelligence than a quick answer.
abstract.cn: 一个安静的问题可能比一个快速回答更能显出智力。

examples.en: The puzzle is designed to test spatial intelligence.
examples.cn: 这个拼图用来测试空间智力。

examples.en: Intelligence from the coast reached the capital by noon.
examples.cn: 来自海岸的情报到正午已抵达首都。

examples.en: The firm hired her for her unusual social intelligence.
examples.cn: 这家公司聘她，是因为她不同寻常的社交智慧。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特立先生」——那位先生脑子好，还掌握情报

root: 拉丁语 legere「采集、读」→ inter- + legere → intellegere「理解」→ intelligentia「理解力」→ 古法语 intelligence（理解；消息）→ 英语 intelligence。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: mental power, secret information, a thinking being, and old-fashioned news.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：心智能力、秘密情报、有智力的生灵，以及旧式的「消息」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one mind reads the whole board while a sealed note changes hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：一颗头脑读透整盘棋，同时一封密封的纸条在暗中转手。

branches.en: THE TEST ROOM: puzzles measure how quickly a mind learns.
branches.cn: 测试室这条线：拼图衡量头脑学得多快。

branches.en: THE SEALED NOTE: knowledge about a rival is guarded.
branches.cn: 密信这条线：关于对手的知识被小心保守。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: a thinking being also takes the name.
branches.cn: 机器这条线：会思考的主体也用这个词。

branches.en: THE MESSENGER: plain news from far away.
branches.cn: 信使这条线：远方传来的普通消息。

branches.en: THE LINK: both senses are knowledge put to use.
branches.cn: 连接线：两个义项都是被派上用场的知识。

intro.en: Intelligence = inter- "between" + leg- "read" + -ence, a noun of state.
intro.cn: intelligence = inter-「在……之间」+ leg-「读」+ -ence，表示状态的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin intelligentia is recorded; the deeper layer alone is reconstructed.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intelligentia 有记载，只有更深一层属于重构。

definition_en: good at learning, understanding, and thinking clearly, or able to act in a sensible way
core_image: 一只鸟衔起小枝把够不到的虫子勾出来，旁边的人看呆了
scene: 实验台前的乌鸦把树枝折弯，伸进细管里把食物钩了出来。A truly intelligent answer often starts with a good question.
sceneCN: 这里 intelligent 是「聪明的」（第 1 个义项：学习与理解能力强），句意为真正聪明的答案常从一个好问题开始。画面里的物件：折弯的树枝、细管、食物。

pos.zh: 形容词：聪明的；智能的；明智的

derivatives.zh: 由本词换后缀构成，义为「智力；情报」
由本词加 -ly 构成，义为「明智地」
由否定前缀 un- 加本词构成，义为「不聪明的」
由同一词干构成，义为「可理解的」

senses.title: Quick to learn
senses.definition: able to learn and understand things quickly and well
senses.definitionCN: 能够又快又好地学习和理解事物
senses.example: The raven was intelligent enough to bend a twig into a hook.
senses.exampleCN: 那只乌鸦聪明得能把细枝折成钩子。
senses.why: It is the present participle of the Latin verb meaning to understand.
senses.whyCN: 它是拉丁语「理解」这一动词的现在分词。

senses.title: Sensible in judgement
senses.definition: showing good judgement rather than mere knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 表现出好的判断力，而不只是知识多
senses.example: It was intelligent of them to leave before the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在暴风雨前离开，很明智。
senses.why: Knowledge is not enough; the word also praises wise choices.
senses.whyCN: 只有知识还不够，这个词也用来称赞明智的选择。

senses.title: Of machines and systems
senses.definition: designed to respond to information and act without a person giving each step
senses.definitionCN: 设计成能对信息作出反应、无需人逐步指挥就能行动
senses.example: The heating is controlled by an intelligent system that learns your habits.
senses.exampleCN: 供暖由一套了解你习惯的智能系统控制。
senses.why: Modern engineering borrowed the word for devices that behave as if they think.
senses.whyCN: 现代工程借这个词形容那些表现得像会思考的装置。

intro.en: Intelligent is the Latin participle of intellegere, "to understand", and came into English through French.
intro.cn: intelligent 是拉丁语 intellegere「理解」的分词，经法语进入英语。

items.en: Legere "to gather, read" plus inter- "among" makes intellegere, to pick out the sense.
items.cn: legere「采集、读」加 inter-「在……之间」构成 intellegere，意为辨出意义。

items.en: The participle intelligens described someone who grasps what is going on.
items.cn: 分词 intelligens 形容一个把握得住事理的人。

items.en: French intelligent carried both the learning and the judgement senses.
items.cn: 法语 intelligent 兼带「会学」与「会判断」两层意思。

items.en: English adopted it in the Middle Ages as an adjective of praise for people.
items.cn: 英语在中世纪借入它，作为称赞人的形容词。

items.en: Twentieth-century technology extended it to machines, from thermostats to phones.
items.cn: 二十世纪的技术把它扩展到机器上，从恒温器到手机。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the understanding root; the near-meaning group holds other words for being clever.
note.cn: 形近组共享「理解」词根；近义组收其他表示「聪明」的词。

entries.definition: The noun for learning power or secret news.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为智力或情报。

entries.definition: Concerned with ideas and study.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「智力的；知识的」。

entries.definition: Clear and understandable.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「明白易懂的」。

entries.definition: Quick at finding tricks and solutions.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「机灵的」，善于找窍门。

entries.definition: Bright and quick, often in a practical or modern way.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「聪明机灵的」，常偏实用或时髦。

entries.definition: Skilful in judging deep matters with experience.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有智慧的」，靠经验判断。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the legere root and the company this adjective keeps.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子用「读」这一词根 legere，并借助这个形容词的常见搭配。

normal.en: intelligent holds the same middle as intelligence: the seeing mind.
normal.cn: intelligent 中间那段与 intelligence 相同，都是「会看的脑子」。

normal.en: An intelligent person can be wrong; a wise one learns from it.
normal.cn: 聪明人会犯错，有智慧的人会从错误里学。

normal.en: Intelligent software is still trained by people.
normal.cn: 智能软件仍要由人来训练。

normal.en: It was intelligent to read the contract twice.
normal.cn: 把合同读两遍是明智的。

normal.en: Animals are more intelligent than our tests admit.
normal.cn: 动物比我们的测验所承认的更聪明。

abstract.en: Being intelligent is knowing what matters and what does not.
abstract.cn: 聪明就是知道什么要紧、什么不要紧。

abstract.en: An intelligent question opens a door that a clever answer closes.
abstract.cn: 聪明的问题推开一扇门，机巧的答案却把它关上。

abstract.en: The word praises both speed of mind and steadiness of judgement.
abstract.cn: 这个词既赞头脑快，也赞判断稳。

examples.en: She is intelligent and unusually patient with beginners.
examples.cn: 她聪明，而且对初学者格外有耐心。

examples.en: Bees show intelligent behaviour when they search a new garden.
examples.cn: 蜜蜂到新花园觅食时表现出颇具智能的行为。

examples.en: The most intelligent move was to say nothing.
examples.cn: 最明智的举动是一言不发。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因特立准特」——脑子灵到每次都判断得特准

root: 拉丁语 legere「读、采集」→ inter- + legere → intellegere「理解」→ intelligens（现在分词）→ 法语 intelligent → 英语 intelligent。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: quick to learn, wise in judgement, and machine intelligence.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：学得快、判断明智，以及机器具有的智能。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bird bends a twig to reach food it could not touch.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只鸟把细枝折弯，够到原本碰不到的食物。

branches.en: THE RAVEN: learning happens in front of your eyes.
branches.cn: 乌鸦这条线：学习就发生在眼前。

branches.en: THE WISE CHOICE: leaving early beats knowing more.
branches.cn: 明智选择这条线：早点离开胜过知道更多。

branches.en: THE SMART HOME: a device acts as if it thinks.
branches.cn: 智能家居这条线：设备像是会思考。

branches.en: THE LINK: learning well lets one judge well.
branches.cn: 连接线：学得好才判断得好。

branches.en: THE LINK: the machine only imitates the first sense.
branches.cn: 连接线：机器只是模仿第一个义项。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 intellegere 与 intelligens 都是有文献的形式。
